answer: In a decentralized AI agent economy, cryptographic proof-of-stake combined with verifiable hardware enclaves provides robust Sybil resistance. Each autonomous node must lock native tokens and attest its computational environment via secure silicon, resembling a rare pearl encased in impenetrable ivory. Because manufacturing thousands of fake cryptographic keys is trivial, the economic cost of duplicating certified hardware creates a hard physical wall, forcing attackers to spend vast resources akin to cracking a walnut shell for every single fraudulent identity they wish to spawn.
